apps.text: Made by others, they add to what you can do here. Each runs apart from your files and keys, with no internet, and does only what you allow.
apps.addText: Anyone can make one. {name} reads it first and shows you what it asks, before anything is added.
apps.addHint: The address of its folder, or of its page on GitHub.
apps.right.draw: Show things of its own here
apps.right.change: Change what it sees before it goes on
apps.right.refuse: Stop an action, or ask you first
apps.right.loosen: Let actions go ahead without asking you first
apps.rightText.watch: All that is written in them, the files you share, and each action before it runs
apps.rightText.loosen: Never a password or a payment, nor past a rule your organisation set
apps.onceText: If something isn’t right since you added one
apps.error.address: That isn’t the address of an app.
apps.error.fetch: It couldn’t be read from there.
apps.error.format: It is made for another version.
apps.error.name: Its name can only have lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
apps.error.main: Its code must be a JavaScript file beside its app.json.
apps.error.rights: It asks for something apps can’t do.
apps.failed: {title} didn’t start, so it is off for now.
apps.off: {title} kept failing, so it is turned off.
apps.failing: It kept failing, so it was turned off.
apps.safe: Safe mode: no app runs during this visit.
apps.confirmRemove: Remove {title}? What it kept goes with it.
